title: Due partial run request/profile version 1
description: Defaults for one foreground Claude Code or Codex run. Explicit CLI execution options override these fields; validate the merged invocation before execution. Output, tracing, binary, and dry-run controls stay on the CLI.
$comment: This schema checks document shape before CLI overlay. Due also rejects duplicate keys and validates the final provider, nonempty prompt/model/resume, effort, positive duration, resume/ephemeral combination, paths and native argument conflicts after merging. An overwritten semantic value need not be valid, but bad JSON types, unknown keys and unsupported schema_version always fail. This schema does not validate provider answer-schema constraints.

provider.description: Provider for the final merged invocation must be claude or codex. May be omitted when --provider supplies it; null is invalid.

prompt.description: Literal prompt text, with no recursive file or stdin references. Final merged prompt must contain a non-whitespace character. May be omitted when --prompt or --stdin supplies it; null is invalid.

model.description: Native model name or alias; omitted or null keeps the provider default.

effort.description: Final merged effort is low, medium or high. Omitted or null keeps the provider default.

cwd.description: Child working directory, resolved from the caller's cwd; omitted or null uses the caller's cwd.

timeout.description: Positive duration accepted by Due, for example 30s or 5m. Runtime validation checks syntax and positivity. Omitted or null means no deadline.

schema.description: Model-answer JSON Schema filename, resolved from the caller's cwd; omitted or null requests no answer schema.

resume.description: Native session or thread ID. A non-null value conflicts with ephemeral true.

ephemeral.description: Native session persistence opt-out. --ephemeral or --no-ephemeral explicitly overrides this setting. Final true conflicts with a resume ID.

native_args.description: Ordered provider option tokens. CLI options after -- replace this entire list; --clear-native-args discards it. Final merged tokens are validated without shell evaluation.
